pages.text: Every piece of lost technology is held by something that will fight to keep it. Beat it and it drops a $(bold)Blueprint$(): the knowledge of how the thing was made.$(br2)Use the Blueprint and you can build that technology. Nobody else can until they learn it too.

Knowledge is a thing you can hand to someone. Trade Blueprints, gift them, loot them from the fallen. Civilization recovers by sharing what it recovers.$(br2)You are not expected to do this alone. Towns, recruits, dogs and other settlers are all part of the plan.

$(bold)What this almanac is not:$() a manual for every mod. Create has ponder scenes (hold $(bold)W$() over any of its items). EMI shows every recipe ($(bold)R$() over an item). Jade names whatever you look at.$(br2)This book tells you how the pieces fit, which doors are closed, and which bosses hold the keys.
